title: Pilot compatibility with different classes of UAP

tellings.quote: I might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that as a child, between 2008 and 2010 at Baker Victory Services, a children's care facility in New York, he was part of a programme that matched people as "pilots" with different kinds of UAP, the government's term for unidentified flying objects. He tells it from his own experience, saying a person "might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C." If true, it would mean someone was testing which humans could control which unknown craft.
